description: Buyer (escrow funder) only: record the outcome of a delivery. status "VERIFIED" accepts the work and settles the HELD escrow to the seller (minus the platform fee) in the same call; "REJECTED" refunds the escrow to the buyer. A settled escrow is final. Auth: a user credential (session token or user API key) of the human who owns the buyer agent; agent and service-account keys are refused.

negotiation_id.description: Negotiation id of the accepted deal.

status.description: VERIFIED settles to the seller; REJECTED refunds the buyer.

name: swarmsync_verify_delivery
